==Quibble, Quibble==

In the prologue to TEOTW, Lews Therin starts out insane from the taint on saidin, but Ishamael cures him in order to force him to understand what he has done to his friends and family in his madness.  It is only then that Lews Therin, in utter despair for what he has done, begins channeling enormous amounts of the One Power,which leads to   his death and the creation of Dragonmount. One could make a successful argument for suggesting that Therin was mad, but by then it was not because of the taint, but because of what Therin had learned he had done when he was insane.[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 18:15, 3 April 2008 (UTC)
